sn20.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati.
sn20.10:1.5: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno na ramati.
sn20.10:1.6: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū …pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn20.10:1.7: “idha bhante aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati.
sn20.10:1.10: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno na ramatī”ti.
sn20.10:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, biḷālo sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ magayamāno,
sn20.10:2.2: “yadāyaṃ mudumūsī gocarāya pakkamissati, tattheva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmī”ti.
sn20.10:2.3: atha kho bhikkhave, mudumūsī gocarāya pakkami.
sn20.10:2.4: tamenaṃ biḷālo gahetvā sahasā asaṃkhāditvā ajjhohari.
sn20.10:2.5: tassa so mudumūsī antampi khādi, antaguṇampi khādi.
sn20.10:2.6: so tato nidānaṃ maraṇampi nigacchi, maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
sn20.10:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati, arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
sn20.10:3.2: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā.
sn20.10:3.3: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
sn20.10:3.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.10:3.5: maraṇaṃ hetaṃ bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
sn20.10:3.6: maraṇamattaṃ hetaṃ bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
sn20.10:3.9: “rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā”ti.
